claims.statement: Provide unique actionable information per metric.
Avoid several highly correlated metrics that add little information.
Review current metrics and the field including CRAP before proposing initiatives.
Research and planning are authorized; application implementation remains planned.
Select a compact portfolio using stratified association and source-backed decision cases.

shape.appetite: Small isolated local proofs; no enterprise infrastructure or compatibility layers.
shape.problem: Select a compact portfolio using stratified association and source-backed decision cases.
shape.recommended_shape: A metric portfolio that earns its attention
success_moves: Use deterministic observation artifacts before scanning a broad corpus.
Start with three repositories and stop before twelve unless useful.
Compare compact and full catalogs so the favored approach can lose.
Keep Byron adjudication separate from automated case preparation.

first_proof.question: Does evaluation distinguish mathematical overlap, missing support and useful exceptions?
first_proof.artifact: Deterministic comparison Markdown/JSON with constant and equal-CCN cases.
first_proof.decision_rule: Reject the method if missing data earns independence or high correlation alone removes a useful exception.

repository_snapshot.worktree_status: Research/planning documents only; no application implementation.

dependencies.name: Corrected corpus observations and human decisions
dependencies.application_seam: Standalone evaluation input manifest and saved observations

first_proof_role.rationale: Deterministic counterexamples can reject the analysis method before any real corpus or human review.

dependencies.local_proof: Fixed observation fixtures with known useful exceptions and missingness.
dependencies.live_proof: Three explicitly authorized pinned repositories and Byron action review; no hosted system.
dependencies.rollout: Optional input or coherent commit; omit/revert without parallel API support.

milestones.title: The evaluation catches misleading metric relationships
milestones.outcome: A deterministic report reveals undefined associations, support rates and useful exceptions.
milestones.proof: Known equal-size/equal-CCN, constant, unavailable and rare-exception cases reproduce.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: A deterministic report reveals undefined associations, support rates and useful exceptions. Existing source-only scanning remains usable.
milestones.rollback: Revert the scoped milestone commit or omit optional evidence; no stored-data migration.

milestones.title: Three repositories yield a reviewable portfolio decision
milestones.outcome: A pinned three-repository pilot records decisions for compact and full portfolios.
milestones.proof: Manifest, size/language strata, rank overlap and shuffled human action review; no broad validity claims.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: A pinned three-repository pilot records decisions for compact and full portfolios. Existing source-only scanning remains usable.
milestones.rollback: Revert the scoped milestone commit or omit optional evidence; no stored-data migration.
